population: Consenting adults; no automated recruitment or uniqueness verification
consent: Participation is voluntary. Use fictional tasks and no personal payment/account information. You may stop and request removal of the local record. Exports already downloaded cannot be recalled. No payment, model dispatch or retailer order is part of this pilot.

tasks.brief: Use the fictional fixture collection. Plan two Full HD displays under USD 350 while retaining one monitor. Inspect consequential facts and identify anything still unknown.
Simulate the chosen dock becoming unavailable. Review a replacement or explain why the task must defer. Never approve checkout.
Review an explicitly hypothetical source replacement in the workbench. Explain why the previous recommendation is cleared and why the changed field needs inspection again.

comprehension.question: Does a supported recommendation authorize a payment?
Does manufacturer-source review equal a physical hardware test?
Are declared planning allowances guaranteed live merchant prices?

analysis: Descriptive local pilot only. Do not infer unique people, causal benefit or superiority from self-reported/observer-entered records. Do not claim a human study occurred until actual consented records have been collected.
